items.stem: Why does New York State want to turn off Niagara Falls?

choices.text: To satisfy the curiosity of tourists.
choices.zh: 为了满足游客的好奇心。

choices.text: To replace two old stone bridges.
choices.zh: 为了更换两座旧石桥。

choices.text: To enable tourists to visit Goat Island.
choices.zh: 为了使游客能够访问山羊岛。

choices.text: To improve utility services in the state.
choices.zh: 为了改善该州的公用事业服务。

items.stem: What did people find when Niagara Falls was shut off in 1969?

choices.text: Countless tree limbs.
choices.zh: 无数树枝。

choices.text: A few skeletons.
choices.zh: 几具骸骨。

choices.text: Lots of wrecked boats and ships.
choices.zh: 大量损毁的船只。

choices.text: Millions of coins on the bottom.
choices.zh: 底部有数百万枚硬币。

items.stem: What did the Tunisian government do after the gunmen's attack?

choices.text: It suspended diplomatic relations with Libya.
choices.zh: 它中止了与利比亚的外交关系。

choices.text: It urged tourists to leave Tunisia immediately.
choices.zh: 它敦促游客立即离开突尼斯。

choices.text: It shut down two border crossings with Libya.
choices.zh: 它关闭了与利比亚的两个边境口岸。

choices.text: It launched a fierce attack against Islamic State.
choices.zh: 它对伊斯兰国发动了猛烈攻击。

items.stem: What were German and American security experts expected to do in Tunisia?

choices.text: Advise Tunisian civilians on how to take safety precautions.
choices.zh: 就如何采取安全预防措施向突尼斯平民提供建议。

choices.text: Track down the organization responsible for the terrorist attack.
choices.zh: 追查对恐怖袭击负责的组织。

choices.text: Train qualified security personnel for the Tunisian government.
choices.zh: 为突尼斯政府培训合格的安全人员。

choices.text: Devise a monitoring system on the Tunisian border with Libya.
choices.zh: 在突尼斯与利比亚的边境设计一套监控系统。

items.stem: What did the three university students invent?

choices.text: An environment-friendly battery.
choices.zh: 一种环保电池。

choices.text: An energy-saving mobile phone.
choices.zh: 一种节能手机。

choices.text: A plant-powered mobile phone charger.
choices.zh: 一种植物供能的手机充电器。

choices.text: A device to help plants absorb sunlight.
choices.zh: 一种帮助植物吸收阳光的装置。

items.stem: When did they get the idea for the invention?

choices.text: While sitting in their school's courtyard.
choices.zh: 坐在学校庭院里的时候。

choices.text: While playing games on their phones.
choices.zh: 在手机上玩游戏的时候。

choices.text: While solving a mathematical problem.
choices.zh: 解决一道数学题的时候。

choices.text: While doing a chemical experiment.
choices.zh: 做化学实验的时候。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the invention?

choices.text: It increases the applications of mobile phones.
choices.zh: 它增加了手机的应用。

choices.text: It speeds up the process of photosynthesis.
choices.zh: 它加快了光合作用的过程。

choices.text: It improves the reception of mobile phones.
choices.zh: 它改善了手机的信号接收。

choices.text: It collects the energy released by plants.
choices.zh: 它收集植物释放的能量。

items.stem: What did the man do before the telephone conversation?

choices.text: He visited the workshops in the Grimsby plant.
choices.zh: 他参观了Grimsby工厂的车间。

choices.text: He called the woman and left her a message.
choices.zh: 他给这位女士打了电话并留了言。

choices.text: He used stand-ins as replacements on all lines.
choices.zh: 他在所有生产线上使用了替补人员作为替代。

choices.text: He asked a technician to fix the broken production line.
choices.zh: 他请一位技术人员修理损坏的生产线。

items.stem: What does the man say about Line 3 in the Grimsby plant?

choices.text: It is the most modern production line.
choices.zh: 它是最现代化的生产线。

choices.text: It assembles super-intelligent robots.
choices.zh: 它组装超智能机器人。

choices.text: It has stopped working completely.
choices.zh: 它已经完全停止工作了。

choices.text: It is going to be upgraded soon.
choices.zh: 它即将进行升级。

items.stem: What is the man's purpose in calling the woman?

choices.text: To seek her permission.
choices.zh: 征求她的许可。

choices.text: To place an order for robots.
choices.zh: 订购机器人。

choices.text: To request her to return at once.
choices.zh: 请求她立刻回来。

choices.text: To ask for Tom's phone number.
choices.zh: 询问Tom的电话号码。

items.stem: Where is the woman at the time of the conversation?

choices.text: She is on duty.
choices.zh: 她正在值班。

choices.text: She is having her day off.
choices.zh: 她正在休假。

choices.text: She is on sick leave.
choices.zh: 她正在请病假。

choices.text: She is abroad on business.
choices.zh: 她正在国外出差。

items.stem: What did Kerry Burke from New York Daily News say about the man?

choices.text: He saved a baby boy's life.
choices.zh: 他救了一名男婴的生命。

choices.text: He wanted to be a superhero.
choices.zh: 他想成为一名超级英雄。

choices.text: He prevented a train crash.
choices.zh: 他阻止了一场火车事故。

choices.text: He was a witness to an accident.
choices.zh: 他是一起事故的目击者。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man from the conversation?

choices.text: He has a 9-month-old boy.
choices.zh: 他有一个9个月大的男孩。

choices.text: He is currently unemployed.
choices.zh: 他目前处于失业状态。

choices.text: He enjoys the interview.
choices.zh: 他很享受这次采访。

choices.text: He commutes by subway.
choices.zh: 他乘地铁通勤。

items.stem: What caused the incident?

choices.text: A rock on the tracks.
choices.zh: 轨道上的一块石头。

choices.text: A misplaced pushchair.
choices.zh: 一辆放错位置的婴儿车。

choices.text: A strong wind.
choices.zh: 一阵强风。

choices.text: A speeding car.
choices.zh: 一辆超速行驶的汽车。

items.stem: How did the mother react when the incident occurred?

choices.text: She stood motionless in shock.
choices.zh: 她震惊地一动不动地站着。

choices.text: She cried bitterly.
choices.zh: 她痛哭流涕。

choices.text: She called the police at once.
choices.zh: 她立即报了警。

choices.text: She shouted for help.
choices.zh: 她大声呼救。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Maria McCartney?

choices.text: She inherited her family ice-cream business in Billings.
choices.zh: 她在Billings继承了家族的冰淇淋生意。

choices.text: She loved the ice-cream business more than teaching primary school.
choices.zh: 她热爱冰淇淋生意胜过教小学。

choices.text: She started an ice-cream business to finance her daughter's education.
choices.zh: 她创办了一家冰淇淋生意来资助女儿的教育。

choices.text: She wanted to have an ice-cream truck when she was a little girl.
choices.zh: 她小时候就想拥有一辆冰淇淋车。

items.stem: Why does Maria go into the mobile ice-cream business?

choices.text: To preserve a tradition.
choices.zh: 为了保留一项传统。

choices.text: To amuse her daughter.
choices.zh: 为了取悦她的女儿。

choices.text: To help local education.
choices.zh: 为了帮助当地教育。

choices.text: To make some extra money.
choices.zh: 为了赚些额外的钱。

items.stem: Why does Maria put a donation bucket in her truck?

choices.text: To raise money for business expansion.
choices.zh: 为了筹集资金扩展生意。

choices.text: To make her truck attractive to children.
choices.zh: 为了让她的卡车对孩子们更有吸引力。

choices.text: To allow poor kids to have ice-cream too.
choices.zh: 为了让贫困的孩子也能吃到冰淇淋。

choices.text: To teach kids the value of mutual support.
choices.zh: 为了教孩子们互相支持的价值。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly talk about?

choices.text: The reasons for imposing taxes.
choices.zh: 征税的原因。

choices.text: The various services money can buy.
choices.zh: 金钱可以购买的各种服务。

choices.text: The various burdens on ordinary citizens.
choices.zh: 普通公民承担的各种负担。

choices.text: The function of money in the modern world.
choices.zh: 金钱在现代世界中的功能。

items.stem: What is most of the government money used for?

choices.text: Educating and training citizens.
choices.zh: 教育和培训公民。

choices.text: Improving public transportation.
choices.zh: 改善公共交通。

choices.text: Protecting people's life and property.
choices.zh: 保护人们的生命和财产。

choices.text: Building hospitals and public libraries.
choices.zh: 建设医院和公共图书馆。

items.stem: How did the government raise money to pay public bills in the past?

choices.text: By asking for donations.
choices.zh: 通过请求捐赠。

choices.text: By selling public lands.
choices.zh: 通过出售公共土地。

choices.text: By selling government bonds.
choices.zh: 通过出售政府债券。

choices.text: By exploiting natural resources.
choices.zh: 通过开发自然资源。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Monaco?

choices.text: It is located at the center of the European continent.
choices.zh: 它位于欧洲大陆的中心。

choices.text: It relies on tourism as its chief source of revenues.
choices.zh: 它依靠旅游业作为主要收入来源。

choices.text: It contains less than a square mile of land.
choices.zh: 它的土地面积不到一平方英里。

choices.text: It is surrounded by France on three sides.
choices.zh: 它三面被法国包围。

items.stem: Why did Monaco become familiar to Americans according to the speaker?

choices.text: Its beauty is frequently mentioned in American media.
choices.zh: 它的美景经常在美国媒体中被提及。

choices.text: Its ruler Prince Rainier married an American actress.
choices.zh: 它的统治者雷尼尔三世亲王娶了一位美国女演员。

choices.text: It is where many American movies are shot.
choices.zh: 它是许多美国电影的拍摄地。

choices.text: It is a favorite place Americans like to visit.
choices.zh: 它是美国人喜欢游览的地方。

items.stem: What is one of the products Andorra exports?

choices.text: Tobacco.
choices.zh: 烟草。

choices.text: Potatoes.
choices.zh: 马铃薯。

choices.text: Machinery.
choices.zh: 机械。

choices.text: Clothing.
choices.zh: 服装。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly talk about?

choices.text: European history.
choices.zh: 欧洲历史。

choices.text: European geography.
choices.zh: 欧洲地理。

choices.text: Small countries in Europe.
choices.zh: 欧洲的小国。

choices.text: Tourist attractions in Europe.
choices.zh: 欧洲的旅游景点。
